name: poly_radical_coprime_derivative_quot
statement: {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (f : Polynomial k) (hf : f ≠ 0) : IsCoprime (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical f) (Polynomial.derivative f / (f / UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical f))
closed: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (f : Polynomial k) (hf : f ≠ 0), IsCoprime (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical f) (Polynomial.derivative f / (f / UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical f))
informal: Snyder's ingredient, sharp form in char 0: the cofactor f' / (f / rad f) is coprime to rad f (so gcd(f, f') is associated to f / rad f) — Uses Mathlib2.ms_divrad_dvd_derivative_v2 to know the division is exact; then for each prime p ∣ f with multiplicity e, f = p^e·g gives f'/(f/rad f) ≡ e·p'·rad(g)·(g/..) mod p, which is nonzero mod p since e ≠ 0 in char 0 and p ∤ p'.
type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (f : Polynomial k), f ≠ 0 → IsCoprime (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical f) (Polynomial.derivative f / (f / UniqueFactorizationMonoid.radical f))
